stem: A grower adds high-velocity fans because a canopy zone has stagnant air. What is the best validation step?
choices: Verify air movement at canopy positions and check for excessive leaf movement or new spatial stress
Assume more fan speed is always better
Judge airflow only from fan wattage
rationale: Airflow changes should be validated at plant level. Excessive or poorly distributed flow can create new problems even when stagnant zones improve.
